hook: India's extreme poverty: *27.1% to 2.6%* in 12 years.
hook_b: India's extreme poverty: *27.1% to 2.6%* in 12 years.
tldr: A World Bank report says India's extreme poverty fell from 27.1% to 2.6% in 12 years.

beats.what: NDTV reports the World Bank figure: extreme poverty down from 27.1% to 2.6% over 12 years.
beats.why: People below the lower-middle-income line of USD 4.20 a day (2021 PPP) fell from 57.7% to 16.1%.
beats.care: The 2.6% uses the extreme line. At the higher USD 4.20 line, 16.1% are still below it.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: NDTV, citing the World Bank: extreme poverty 27.1% to 2.6%; share below USD 4.20 per day (2021 PPP) 57.7% to 16.1%. The report's start and end years were not in the summary.

cards.q: Does '2.6% extreme poverty' match what you see around you?
opts: The poverty line seems too low

learn.t: PPP adjusts for what money buys in each country, so USD 4.20 PPP is not the same as USD 4.20 at the exchange rate.

watch: Debate on which poverty line India should use.

sources.name: NDTV
sources.title: India's Extreme Poverty Drops From 27.1% To 2.6% In 12 Years: World Bank

insight: At the USD 4.20 a day line, 16.1% are still below it.
